content: 1. Hydroxyzine is used intramuscularly (IM) at a dose of 1 mg/kg for symptomatic relief of anxiety associated with psychoneurosis and as an adjunct in organic disease states. 2. For oral (PO) administration, hydroxyzine is dosed at 50-100 mg divided every 6 hours, or 50-100 mg IM divided every 4-6 hours. 3. Continuation of therapy beyond 4 months has not been studied; the need for ongoing therapy should be reassessed periodically. 4. In elderly patients, the initial dose should be at the lower end of the dosage range due to reduced drug clearance and an increased risk of confusion, dry mouth, constipation, and other anticholinergic effects or toxicities. Close monitoring is recommended. 5. Hydroxyzine and dronedarone both prolong the QTc interval and are contraindicated due to the risk of arrhythmias. 6.
